identityAllocation: Separately authorized creation only: allocate UUIDv7 once with maintained RFC9562 library; persist a reviewed draft-key-to-ID registry. Never derive canonical IDs from spelling, hashes or these editorial keys.

mapping.lemma: owner-selected lexical form, not automatic normalized candidate spelling
mapping.normalizedLemma: Apply existing NFKC-LOWER-EN-1 canonical policy after lexical-unit review; source NFC/casefold remains evidence
mapping.aliases: Reviewed variants with provenance, never silently merge a, an

lexeme.reuse: Require lexical identity proof under exact pinned records; otherwise separately approve creation. Compositional expressions may be deferred rather than become Lexemes.

mapping.partOfSpeechCode: reviewed partOfSpeechProposal; OTHER requires explicit construction/number decision
mapping.translations: meaningVi -> vi Translation with translationKind and preferred/order selected by owner
mapping.examples: each en/vi pair -> Example and distinct ExampleTranslation

sense.reuseOrCreate: Reuse only with Sense identity proof; similar text/POS is insufficient. Existing accepted identities preserve meaning. A distinct meaning gets a separately allocated ID, not a recycled runtime identity.
sense.childIds: Allocate separate UUIDv7 for Definition, Translation, Example and ExampleTranslation at authorized creation; preserve across revisions.

revisionStrategy: Append new immutable files with positive entity revision; exact identity continuity reviewed. Never overwrite 87 approved Lexemes/100 Senses or a pinned revision. Same-identity corrections get reviewed next revisions; distinct meanings require separate identities.

provenance.fieldMapping: One field-level claim per authored child/field with subjectId, fieldPath, drafting process and persisted text hash; create real human OWNER_REVIEW provenance only after actual review
provenance.rightsGate: Generated draft does not clear source rights or guarantee publication permission. Owner must establish permissible original content, any attribution obligations and license basis; never label AI prose PROJECT_AUTHORED by a fictional human.

classifications.cefr: Source evidence -> separately reviewed Sense classification with CEFR framework/version and Provenance; no default A1, no direct grade conversion
classifications.otherDimensions: Difficulty needs an approved scale/rubric; school requires curriculum/level; age/topic/domain/exam need explicit evidence and reviewed taxonomy refs; Learning Set requires selection provenance and ordered membership
classifications.taxonomy: Use pinned immutable taxonomy snapshots and exact existing concepts; no automatic label-to-ID mapping.

release.pins: Exact typed IDs, revisions, recordPath and RFC8785 canonical contentHash; no latest-record fallback
release.hash: Existing sha256-canonical-json-v1; releaseHash over canonical manifest with only releaseHash omitted
release.validation: Existing Ajv schemas plus cross-file release validator, reference/provenance closure, reviewed content, rights and independent explicit release authorization; APPROVED gate only after these pass

runtimeBoundary: No runtime IDs, maps, DB operations or Development apply. New Master -> Approved release -> separately authorized Development reconciliation/apply -> legacy transition.
